wordmark.fontFamily: Baskerville, "Baskerville Old Face", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif
wordmark.note: Same face and caret animation everywhere the wordmark or a single W appears, including inside cards. Do not substitute a different serif in a new surface.

heading.note: No eyebrow labels above headings anywhere in the product.

monoNumeric.usage: Counters and any live numeric value (amounts, quantities, countdowns)

motion.reducedMotion: All motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable entirely rather than reduce.

secureCard.note: Secure user cards (payment, credential, connector) reuse this token set exactly: paper background, ink text, hairline borders, 10px radius controls, same primary button style, same wordmark treatment if a header is present. No new colour, type, or radius scale for cards.
secureCard.urlFormat: wis.ai/c/{shortcode}, short-path only, never a long signed query string, must read cleanly in a mobile chat thread
